findings.message: 4 tl.fromTo() calls target "#s4-today" with no stable baseline. The last-authored fromTo "from" values become the element's resting state for any seek before the first tween actually runs, because GSAP applies fromTo from-values at authoring time (immediateRender), not at tween position.
findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to every fromTo except the earliest-positioned one (at 0.62s), so pre-first-tween seeks keep its "from" values. A hiding `tl.set(..., 0)` baseline trips gsap_timeline_set_initial_hide, and a `gsap.set` authored before the fromTo calls is overwritten by them.

findings.message: Positioned element renders far outside its offset parent — its coordinates were likely computed in a different frame (canvas/viewport pixels).
findings.fixHint: Compute left/top in the offset parent's frame (subtract its rect), or mark intentional placement with data-layout-allow-overflow.
